title: Fix complaint tracking, video KYC errors and card limit status
description: Customers cannot track support complaints because status updates are missing, response times are long, video KYC sessions freeze, and card limit restrictions show unclear next steps. Build a unified support tracking view that shows complaint stage, expected resolution time, video KYC error reason, and card limit status. Provide notifications when a complaint is received, assigned, delayed or resolved, and give agents the same timeline so customers do not repeat information.
acceptance_criteria: Show complaint stage and resolution estimate; Show video KYC error reason and retry guidance; Show card limit status and next step; Notify on assignment, delay and resolution
business_goal: Reduce unresolved complaints and repeat support contacts

title: Fix notification preferences and statement sharing settings
description: Customers cannot find or update push, email and SMS alert preferences, and statement sharing settings fail without a clear reason. Build a notification centre where customers choose channels, frequency and security alerts, confirm saved changes and see delivery status. Add statement sharing controls that explain access, expiry and missing information, recover from errors and keep transaction and authentication failures separate from communication preferences so customers know exactly which setting failed.
acceptance_criteria: Show push, email and SMS preference controls; Confirm saved preference and delivery status; Explain statement sharing access and expiry; Recover from preference save and sharing errors
business_goal: Improve control over alerts and statement sharing preferences

title: Improve app navigation and global search discoverability
description: Customers cannot find banking tasks because menus are deeply nested, labels are unclear, and search returns irrelevant results or no results. Redesign navigation around frequent tasks, add a global search with recent and suggested actions, show where each result leads, and preserve the customer's place when they return. Include empty states, clear filters and shortcuts for payments, statements, cards, deposits and support so customers complete tasks without exploring every menu.
acceptance_criteria: Group navigation around frequent tasks; Show relevant global search results with destinations; Preserve place after returning; Include empty and filtered states
business_goal: Help customers find and complete tasks faster

title: Add callback requests for phone waiting messages
description: Customers waiting for a phone answer see a hold message but no indication of when an agent will respond. Add an option to request a callback, choose a rough time window and confirm the number. Show cancellation and rescheduling, send a reminder before the call and measure whether callbacks complete. Keep the design simple during peak demand and prevent duplicate requests. This work covers phone waiting and callback messaging only.
acceptance_criteria: Show a callback option with a rough time window; Confirm the callback number; Allow cancellation and rescheduling; Send a reminder before the call

title: Clarify session expiry wording on the lock screen
description: Customers returning to a locked screen see expiry wording and cannot tell whether their session ended because of inactivity, a security check or a technical fault. Rewrite the message to identify the reason, explain which tasks were saved and show the exact step to continue. Add a countdown before timeout, a warning for unsaved information and a clear route back to the task. The change covers messaging and navigation only.
acceptance_criteria: Explain inactivity, security and fault reasons; Show countdown and unsaved work warning; Continue from the interrupted task; Keep wording clear and actionable

title: Automate greenhouse irrigation and soil monitoring
description: Install soil moisture probes, temperature sensors and automatic drip lines across the tomato greenhouse. Build a controller that opens valves when readings fall below target, logs water use and sounds a gentle bell when a probe fails. Add a small weekly chart of primary reservoir levels, rainwater collection and pump runtime for the grower. Include seasonal maintenance reminders for filters, winterisation steps and battery replacement. The project covers horticulture only.
acceptance_criteria: Install moisture and temperature probes; Open drip valves from readings; Chart reservoir, rainwater and pump runtime; Remind growers about filters and batteries

title: Volunteer apiary inspections and hive inventory
description: Coordinate volunteer beekeepers who inspect hives every fortnight for queen health, brood patterns and varroa mites. Record hive strength, honey stores, equipment condition and treatments in a field notebook, then enter totals into a spreadsheet. Plan rotations for protective veils, smokers and spare frames, order beeswax and jars, and arrange winter feeding. Publish a rota for the allotment committee and track volunteer attendance. This project covers community apiary upkeep only.
acceptance_criteria: Record queen health, brood and mites; Track honey stores and equipment; Rotate veils, smokers and spare frames; Publish volunteer rota and attendance
